title: Choose which unblocked items start together
what: Decide, from the real state, which unblocked queue items to start when slots are free, so that parallel changes do not pay for colliding (take-master, gate reruns, conflicts resolved by hand) and slots do not stand idle. Design first: measure the last days (merges git combined or that conflicted and what each cost, idle slots, how well items' where lines matched the files their branches changed), compare at least: predicting overlap from the files items name plus the real diffs of running branches; starting any unblocked item and letting the merge train absorb collisions; what merge queues and build tools do (GitHub merge queue, bors, Nx/Turborepo affected, Bazel); and doing nothing. Uses the dependency tree (blocked_by) only as input.
why: Owner, 24 Oct: "в одном механизме ты объединил ответственность древа зависимостей и планировщика задач"; "Лучше делать выбор на основе реального положения вещей". A dry run (scratchpad reports/ready-dryrun.txt) found 17 of 28 open items with ip >= 88 overlapping a running branch; after a compaction the front ran 2 of 4 slots. IP chosen by the front (agent-chosen).
failing_case: On 24 Oct with three branches running, the front picked the next items by reading 40 where lines by hand, and earlier left 2 of 4 slots idle.
pass_cases: A design with the measured numbers and at least three approaches plus doing nothing, reviewed, and the owner's pick recorded before any build.
where: .relay/queue/choose-which-unblocked-items-start-together.json to be designed (design track first): the front skill, the change-cycle workflow, possibly a queue view

fact: Migration 27 Oct: the link in `why` line 1 points to a session file (`reports/ready-dryrun.txt`, in the session session folder; a copy is in relay's backup folder), which is deleted when the machine restarts; the facts it held that this item rests on are the notes below.

Measured 24 Oct with a dry run of a `relay queue ready` prototype: the running branches were openspec-optional (153 changed lines), rules-gate (3) and quick-head (3); of the 28 queue items with ip 88 and above it listed, 17 had to WAIT because their files overlap a running branch (most through plugins/delegate/skills/delegate/SKILL.md, lib/relay_setup.py, bin/relay and rules/*.md with openspec-optional) and 11 could START.

said: Возьми fix evidence в работу параллельно, почему мне приходится напоминать об этом каждый раз, что блокирует автоматический процесс взятия задачи в исполнение ?
